description: 同花顺iFinD金融数据查询，查询股票、基金、宏观经济、行业经济、新闻公告、债券、港美股、指数板块及期货期权数据；通过内置智能问数算法，仅少量工具即可覆盖海量投研级金融数据指标，其中A股、中国公募基金、债券交易所、国内指数共4类市场支持日内高频/实时行情的level1数据，同时支持智能选股、选基、宏观行业经济指标搜索、金融公告资讯搜索等服务

display.description_en: THS iFinD Financial Data Query: Access comprehensive data on stocks, funds, macroeconomics, industry economics, news & announcements, bonds, HK/US stocks, indices, sectors, futures, and options. Powered by built-in intelligent natural language query algorithms, it covers a vast array of investment-research-grade financial metrics with minimal tooling. It supports Level-1 intraday high-frequency/real-time market data for four major markets: A-shares, Chinese public mutual funds, bond exchanges, and domestic indices. Additional features include smart stock screening, fund selection, macro/industry economic indicator search, and financial announcement & news search.
